# Handel Luxe GH

> Handel Luxe GH is a Ghanaian online fragrance store selling authentic perfumes, body sprays, deodorants and gift sets, with nationwide delivery across Ghana.

## Products

- 60+ fragrances across 6 categories: Men's, Women's, Unisex, Body Mists & Sprays, Gift Sets, and Deodorants & Roll-Ons.
- Prices in Ghana cedis, from GH₵10 to GH₵450.
- All products sourced from authorized suppliers.
- Product pages: /product/&lt;id&gt; (e.g. /product/15 for Lattafa Khamrah Qahwa).
- Browsing: /products, filterable by category (?category=1-6), sortable by price, searchable.

## Ordering

- Guest checkout available; no account required.
- Payment: online via Paystack (card or mobile money) or cash on delivery.
- Delivery zones: Swedru Central (free), Greater Accra / Central Region (GH₵20), Other Regions (GH₵50), Self-Collection at the Swedru store (free). Fees are set in the admin dashboard, so /faq carries the current list.
- Order tracking: /track-order with order number and checkout email; registered customers see order status under My Orders.

## Policies

- Returns accepted for wrong, damaged/leaking, or inauthentic items; contact within 48 hours of delivery.
- Refunds processed after the returned item is inspected.
- Full policy pages: /privacy, /terms, /refund, /cookies.

## Contact

- Phone/WhatsApp: 0542332244, 0549986486
- Email: drdehandel@gmail.com
- Response within 24 hours, usually same-day during business hours.
- Contact form: /contact
